findings.observation: SCHEMA only calls has_schema_privilege(current_user,current_schema,CREATE); ROLES checks current/session/membership owner/admin flags but not schema CREATE privileges of session_user/reachable roles.
findings.static_counterexample: Session login L has direct CREATE on selected schema but is neither owner nor admin; active SET ROLE A has only USAGE and CRUD, no CREATE. All role/ownership/catalog checks can pass, yielding STRUCTURAL_READY although RESET ROLE L can CREATE. This is a static logical counterexample, NOT actual PG execution.
findings.minimum_change: Either check CREATE of current+session+scope-defined reachable role set for effective schema, or explicitly limit qualification/docs to active current_user CREATE and cease claiming login/reachable least privilege.

findings.observation: engine.dispose() in finally is outside the exception catcher. If disposal/connection-close raises, the fixed JSON failure path is bypassed and an uncaught exception reaches stderr.
findings.minimum_change: Catch cleanup failure too; emit fixed safe unavailable/BLOCKED JSON without exception values or readiness success.
